draw.method: chosen, not drawn: five rows verifier/row-verdicts.json classes sound, one from each difficulty stratum and one held-out, to measure the opening a read that finds nothing wrong produces

rows.note: One or two capitals then one or two digits is the outward code as described.
Four, two and two digits joined by hyphens is the ISO shape the description spells out.
Hyphenated lower-case groups of 8-4-4-4-12 with the version nibble fixed at 4 and the variant nibble in 8-b.
Bracketed alternation of exactly the four levels named.
A captured word, one space, and a backreference to it, bounded as whole words.
